definition.chain: one describe sentence -> R15 two-pass read (earliest key first, same-start abstains, first occurrence masked to the same width) -> the matched (slot, name) -> that entity's original corpus record -> one contiguous byte span of it
definition.unit: the frozen SPEC 16.2 unit: a complete record or a complete sentence. Every record of this fixture is one sentence, so the emitted span is the record's only span; a record with more than one sentence would emit its first sentence (SPEC 16.2 sentence-order tie-break). No third unit and no new numeric tolerance is introduced
definition.address_map: entity -> corpus record indices comes from the fixture metadata (each row carries its object and place), not from text search; when an entity has several records the lowest address wins (SPEC 16.2 address_order). The map is GIVEN, not inferred: this gate measures the handoff from the bridge to the output unit, not retrieval
definition.L1: fabricated bytes 0, illegal slices 0, UTF-8 decodable 100%, boundary legal 100% (boundary legal = the emitted span is one of the spans the frozen ``taiji.sc_sfk.sentences`` rule returns for that record)
definition.L2: provenance fidelity = the emitted bytes equal record[start:end] byte for byte; must be 1.0
definition.L3: four classes per entity slot: answered_correct / pointed_wrong / abstained / should_answer_missing; the entity capability line stays at 40/40 and wrong pointers stay 0
definition.cost_column: faithful_but_other_pairing: the slice is faithful and the entity is right, yet the record's (object, place) is not the asked pair. Reported with samples; never folded into 'correct'
definition.closed_state: the nine closed-state readings stay equal before and after
definition.training: zero training, zero optimizer steps, zero Adam, zero confirm

criteria.l2: provenance fidelity == 1.0 on every emitted output
criteria.l3: answered_correct 40/40, pointed_wrong 0, abstained 0, should_answer_missing 0; the faithful_but_other_pairing column is reported separately with at least one real sample
criteria.abstain: an unknown question emits zero bytes (abstain never falls back to a record)
